title: Banking System Credit-Deposit (CD) Ratio Touches Record 81%
summary: **All-Time High CD Ratio:** Indian commercial banking system Loan-to-Deposit Ratio (LDR / CD Ratio) touched an all-time peak of **81.0% in the December 2025 qua...

items: **All-Time High CD Ratio:** Indian commercial banking system Loan-to-Deposit Ratio (LDR / CD Ratio) touched an all-time peak of **81.0% in the December 2025 quarter**.

**SBI Research Benchmark:** Exceeded the prudential optimum band of **76% to 80%** identified by SBI Economic Research, underscoring credit growth outpacing deposit accretion across scheduled commercial banks.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → System CD ratio touched 81% (exceeding optimum 76-80% band).
